title: Content Assistant
description:
As a Content Assistant in Guildford, you will help create, organise and publish content that supports marketing activity across the Media & Agency sector. You will keep content accurate and well presented, helping campaigns and day-to-day communications run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Media & Agency industry in Guildford.

Description
- Create and format content for marketing campaigns, digital channels and communications.
- Organise content files and maintain clear records so materials are easy to find and use.
- Proofread copy and check content for accuracy, consistency and clear presentation.
- Prepare content for publication across relevant marketing channels.
- Work with marketing colleagues to gather information and turn it into useful content.
- Update existing content to keep messaging current and aligned with campaign needs.
- Track content deadlines and help ensure materials are ready when required.

Profile

A successful Content Assistant should have:
- Experience creating, editing or organising written and digital content.
- A clear writing style and strong attention to detail when proofreading copy.
- The ability to manage several content tasks and keep work on schedule.
- Confidence working with marketing materials and digital content channels.
- Good organisation skills for maintaining content files and records.
- The ability to work closely with colleagues to gather and present information clearly.

Job Offer
- Permanent Content Assistant role based in Guildford.
- Salary of 28,000 to 32,000 dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
After clicking Apply, you'll be invited to create a profile on the Via website to complete your application. This doesn't guarantee you'll be matched to this specific role - Via reviews every application (AI first, then a human checks the fit) and shortlists the right candidates. Full-time Permanent

Via is partnering with a leading UK housebuilder looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to support its digital campaigns, website, content and customer journey.

Working closely with the Head of Digital, you'll help deliver marketing activity across email, PPC, SEO, display advertising, property portals and the company website.

It's a varied role that combines hands-on digital marketing with performance analysis. You'll help keep online content accurate and engaging, support campaigns designed to generate new customer enquiries and use performance data to identify opportunities to improve results.

Previous property or housebuilding experience would be useful but isn't essential. We're more interested in candidates with a good foundation in digital marketing who are comfortable working across several channels and want to develop their skills further.

What you'll be doing
- Coordinate digital marketing campaigns across email, PPC, SEO, display and other channels
- Support listings and campaigns across property portals such as Rightmove
- Help create, schedule and deliver customer email and lifecycle campaigns
- Support marketing automation activity
- Monitor campaigns against agreed KPIs and identify opportunities to improve performance
- Carry out keyword research and support SEO activity
- Make on-page SEO and content improvements
- Maintain and update website content through a CMS
- Ensure online content, imagery and information remain accurate and up to date
- Work with sales teams to maintain property and development information
- Help improve the online customer journey and website user experience
- Support the development and testing of new digital features and tools
- Track website and campaign performance
- Monitor traffic, engagement, conversion rates and cost per lead
- Use Google Analytics, Looker Studio, HubSpot and Excel to analyse performance
- Help produce monthly reports for sales teams and senior stakeholders
- Turn performance data into practical recommendations
- Work with internal teams and external partners on digital projects
- Ensure digital content remains consistent with brand standards
- Support the Head of Digital and wider marketing team with additional projects

What we're looking for
- Previous experience in digital marketing or a broader marketing role with strong digital exposure
- Good understanding of digital marketing fundamentals
- Experience working across multiple digital marketing channels
- Familiarity with website CMS platforms
- Understanding of email marketing and marketing automation
- Familiarity with PPC and digital advertising
- Understanding of SEO principles
- Comfortable working with digital marketing data and performance metrics
- Experience with Google Analytics or similar analytics tools
- Strong Excel skills
- Understanding of the online customer journey and conversion
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good organisation and the ability to manage several priorities at once
- Analytical and curious approach to marketing performance
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills
- Proactive approach and willingness to learn

Experience with HubSpot, Looker Studio, property portals or similar tools would be particularly useful.

Previous experience within housebuilding, property, real estate or another consumer sector with a considered customer journey would be an advantage, but isn't essential.

A marketing, digital, business or related degree would be useful, although equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

Why apply?
- £35,000-£42,000 salary
- Company bonus scheme
- Hybrid and flexible working opportunities
- 25 days' annual leave
- Private healthcare and cash plan options
- Private pension
- ShareSave scheme
- Cycle to work scheme
- Gym membership discounts
- Work across a broad range of digital marketing channels
- Exposure to PPC, SEO, email, CRM, analytics and website optimisation
- Opportunity to work closely with an experienced Head of Digital
- Strong scope for learning and professional development

If you're an early-career digital marketer looking for a varied role where you can build experience across campaigns, content, analytics and customer experience, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
This is a hands-on Digital Marketing Executive role supporting the delivery and optimisation of performance marketing campaigns across channels including Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, YouTube and Demand Generation. You'll work closely with agencies and internal stakeholders to analyse performance, improve ROI, manage campaigns end-to-end and develop your expertise within a leading consumer travel brand.

Client Details

An established organisation within the leisure, travel and tourism industry.

Description
- Support and optimise performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, YouTube and Demand Gen.
- Work with media agencies to launch, manage and improve campaign performance against commercial objectives.
- Monitor budgets and key KPIs including bookings, revenue, CPA, ROAS and conversion performance.
- Analyse campaign data and identify opportunities to improve results and ROI.
- Coordinate campaign delivery from briefing through to launch, optimisation and reporting.
- Ensure creative, targeting, tracking, pricing and promotional details are accurate across all campaigns.
- Produce performance reports and turn data into actionable recommendations.
- Use GA4, SA360 and advertising platforms to understand customer and campaign performance.
- Support testing of audiences, creative, messaging, formats and media channels.
- Develop digital advertising assets with internal teams and external agencies.
- Build strong relationships with agency partners and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Contribute ideas and recommendations to enhance digital marketing effectiveness.

Profile
- 1-4 years' experience in digital or performance marketing, either in-house or agency-side. (PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU HAVE MORE THAN 5 YEARS EXPERIENCE)
- Strong understanding of paid media channels such as Paid Search and Paid Social.
- Commercially minded with an analytical approach to campaign performance and optimisation.
- Confident working with data, reporting tools and spreadsheets to generate insights.
- Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with agencies and stakeholders.
- Proactive, curious and eager to learn and develop within a fast-paced environment.
- Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager or GA4.
- Background in travel, ecommerce or another services-focused business is preferred.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary dependent on the level of experience.
- Hybrid working in Woking or Kent (3 days in the office / 2 days at home)
- 25 days holiday excluding Bank Holidays
- Private Healthcare
- Pension Contribution
- Plus a plethora of other benefits

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive - Integrated Marketing Agency
description:
SEO Content Paid Media Email Social AI Search Client Strategy

Ready to Own More, Influence More and Grow With an Agency?

You've built solid experience in digital marketing. You know how campaigns come together, you're comfortable working with clients, and you're ready for a role where you can take greater ownership rather than simply execute someone else's plan.

Perhaps you're also looking for somewhere you can properly invest yourself. A close-knit agency where you'll be trusted, challenged and given the opportunity to grow as the business grows.

We're an established, award-winning integrated marketing agency entering an exciting new phase of growth, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Digital Marketing Executive to join our team.

This is an opportunity for a capable, proactive marketer who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, taking responsibility and delivering great work across a varied client portfolio.

The Role at a Glance

Senior Digital Marketing Executive
£35,000 - £40,000 DOE
Plus Benefits & Career Progression
Surrey Hybrid - 3 Days Office / 2 Days Home

Full-Time Permanent
Monday-Friday 8.30am-5.00pm

Company: Established Integrated Marketing Agency

Culture: Close-Knit Professional Collaborative Ambitious People First

Your Skills: SEO AI Search Content Marketing Paid Media Email Marketing Social Media Campaign Analytics Client Management

Who We Are

Red Ant is an established integrated marketing agency with more than 20 years' experience delivering high-quality B2 B and B2 C marketing communications across a diverse range of sectors.

Our experienced team specialises in website design and development, branding, digital marketing and creative communications, helping organisations strengthen their brands, improve their digital presence and achieve their business objectives.

We're now entering an exciting new phase of growth and looking for someone who wants to play a meaningful role in what comes next.

We're close-knit, professional and collaborative. We value long-term client relationships and believe the same longevity within our team creates a stronger, more settled business.

The Opportunity

Working closely with the Digital Marketing Manager, you'll take ownership of digital campaigns across a diverse client portfolio, helping to plan, deliver and optimise activity across multiple channels.

You'll combine strategy, creativity and analysis, using campaign performance and insight to identify opportunities and continually improve results.

You'll also contribute to the agency's own marketing and market presence, bringing ideas and helping strengthen how we communicate and grow.

As a close-knit agency, people have visibility and influence here. We're looking for someone who takes responsibility, contributes ideas, follows things through and is happy to get stuck in when needed.

What You'll Bring
- At least 4 years' digital marketing experience, ideally within an agency environment.
- Strong knowledge of content marketing, SEO, AI search, paid media, email marketing and social media.
- Experience analysing campaign performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.
- Excellent written communication and stakeholder management skills.
- The confidence and professional maturity to build credible client relationships.
- A strategic and analytical mindset combined with a willingness to remain hands-on.
- Strong organisation and the ability to manage multiple clients, projects and priorities effectively.
- Commercial awareness and an understanding of how marketing activity supports wider client objectives.
- A proactive, positive approach with the confidence to take ownership and solve problems.
- Curiosity and a genuine commitment to learning and continuous improvement.

Who Will Thrive Here?

This role will suit someone who has built strong foundations in digital marketing and is now looking for somewhere they can develop, take greater ownership and build the next stage of their career.

You'll enjoy being part of a smaller agency where people are trusted to deliver, contribute beyond a narrow job description and support one another when things get busy.

We're looking for someone dependable, motivated and comfortable with responsibility, but also ambitious enough to want to keep learning and take on more as the agency grows.

If you're looking for a role you can genuinely make your own and grow with over time, you'll fit in well here.

What We Offer
- £35,000 - £40,000 starting salary, dependent on experience.
- Hybrid working with 3 days in the Surrey office and 2 days from home.
- The opportunity to make a genuine impact within a growing agency.
- A supportive, close-knit team where your ideas and contributions are valued.
- Ongoing training and professional development.
- Opportunities to progress your career as the agency grows.
- Six-month performance and development review.
- Workplace pension scheme.
- 24 days' annual leave.
- Free onsite parking.

If you've built strong digital marketing experience and you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, contribute properly and grow with an established agency, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your digital marketing career.

title: Social Media and Marketing Executive
description:
About April Quest

April Quest specialises in permanent, contract and executive recruitment across engineering, science and technology. We connect talented people with ambitious businesses and take pride in the relationships we build with our clients, candidates and colleagues.

We re looking for a creative, proactive Social Media and Marketing Executive to help raise our profile, showcase our expertise and bring our company culture to life.

This opportunity would suit a marketing graduate or someone early in their career who enjoys creating content, has plenty of ideas and wants to see their work make a direct impact.

The Role

Working closely with our Managing Director, you ll help develop and deliver a practical social media and marketing strategy that supports attracting new clients and candidates who need specialist recruitment support and talented people to join the April Quest team.

LinkedIn will be your primary focus across all three audiences. You ll also develop our presence on Instagram and Facebook, particularly to showcase life at April Quest and support recruitment into our own business.

We want someone who spots opportunities, suggests fresh ideas and follows them through. You ll have support and direction from the Managing Director, alongside the opportunity to take ownership of day-to-day activity.

Key Responsibilities
- Work with the Managing Director to develop our social media and marketing strategy, agree priorities and turn ideas into achievable campaigns.
- Create and manage a content calendar, balancing industry insights, recruitment expertise, opportunities and company culture.
- Research our audiences, competitors and relevant trends, suggesting new ways to reach and engage the right people.
- Social media and content creation
- Manage our company LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook accounts, tailoring content to each platform and audience.
- Create engaging posts, graphics, photographs and short videos that reflect April Quest s personality and expertise.
- Develop content around the industries we recruit within, including technology developments, hiring challenges, career advice and market insights.
- Turn the team s knowledge and experience into useful content, such as consultant interviews, practical advice and success stories.
- Monitor comments and messages, respond appropriately and direct enquiries to the relevant colleague.
- Capture photographs and videos at team socials, celebrations and company activities.
- Showcase what it s like to work at April Quest through employee stories, behind-the-scenes content and recruitment campaigns.
- Encourage colleagues to contribute ideas, appear in content and participate in social media activity.
- Help the team share relevant company content and strengthen their professional presence on LinkedIn.
- Support website content, blogs, email campaigns and marketing materials where relevant.
- Maintain a consistent tone of voice and visual style across our content.
- Track performance and share straightforward updates on what is working and what could improve.
- Assess success through relevant engagement, client and candidate enquiries, and interest in joining April Quest.
- Handle photographs, testimonials and client or candidate information with appropriate permission and care.

About You

You ll bring:
- Strong writing skills, attention to detail and an ability to adapt your message for different audiences.
- Familiarity with social media and networking platforms
- Creativity and an interest in photography, video and digital content.
- The confidence to suggest ideas, involve colleagues and get things moving.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload.
- Curiosity about engineering, science, technology and the people working in these industries.
- A willingness to learn, test ideas and use feedback to improve.
- A degree in marketing, communications or a related subject would be welcome, but isn t essential. We re equally interested in relevant practical experience.
- Experience with tools such as Canva, video editing software or social media scheduling platforms would be useful. Previous recruitment industry experience is not required.

How To Apply

Please send your CV and a short introduction explaining why this role interests you. If you have examples of social media posts, videos, designs or marketing projects you ve created, we d love to see them.
